liebermann.notes: Collectanea of c. 1625 with the Coronation Charter of Henry I 'ex libro cartarum archiepiscopatus Cantuariensis', in the Westminster text but referring to the privilege of the Canterbury monks.

entries.text_de: British Museum Cotton Vespasian C XIV f. 129, Collectaneen um 1625, CHn cor, u. S. 521, ex libro cartarum archiepiscopatus Cantuariensis, im Texte Westminsters, doch mit Beziehung des Vorrechts der Mönche auf Canterbury.
entries.text_en: British Museum Cotton Vespasian C XIV f. 129, collectanea of c. 1625, CHn cor, below, p. 521, ex libro cartarum archiepiscopatus Cantuariensis, in the Westminster text, but with the privilege of the monks referred to Canterbury.

transcription.doubts: The heading appears to have a dot under the t (Canṭ); possibly a speck, possibly a deliberate mark. Transcribed as plain 'Cant'.
